gaps: There is no current authoritative downstream contract because the confirmed spec supersedes the protected older plan and decomposition.
The settled combined-review reassignment is absent from the protected old plan, decomposition, task plan and D-0032 deferral.
Review proof has incompatible selectors: the amended spec uses task reviews/selected.json while the old plan uses review-run.json and fixed paths.
The one-time fixed-review migration has no producing Portable task contract in the protected old decomposition.
Preliminary-PR requirements conflict between the amended specification, accepted Decision 0054, the old plan and Shared/Integration contracts.
The Format/Quality requirements and Ruff-configuration ownership amendment is absent from the old plan and decomposition.
Canon-write wording conflicts with the preserved strict-role classifier that treats ordinary docs and plans as coordinator-owned surfaces.
Ordinary-chat eligibility conflicts with Decision 0061 when a structured tool exists but is optional-only for native approvals.
Optional non-gate structured questions cannot be represented because every captured round requires a gate.
The structured question identity does not bind the issuance artifact revision and cannot prevent revision-A answers from being rebound to revision B.
Handoff wording conflicts with Decision 0053 by allowing transfer while another required question exchange is incomplete.
Unanswered ordinary-chat questions have no durable collector and can disappear from handoff state.
One protected handoff snapshot is not falsifiable without a lock, generation, coherent fields and refreshed-trunk completion.
The five-row fail-closed claim overstates host behavior for nonblocking SessionStart/PreCompact failures and documented Stop fail-open failures.
The context-capacity contract has impossible read/count ordering, unknown-limit reporting and ambiguous partition launch behavior.
AC6 says only task-bound proof satisfies a gate and thereby invalidates legitimate global and story-scoped gate evidence.
Cross-lens applicability has no coherent deterministic grammar and conflicts with unique finding records.
Mandatory retention behavior has no acceptance predicate for collision refusal, durable readback, deletion safety and legacy immutability.
Genuine native delivery permits an inconsequential post-registration change to claim credit for a prepared capability.
Platform limitation wording can waive mandatory local Mac Desktop proof.
C1 requires undefined setup repair behavior that the capability does not specify.
The specification denies owning the delivery graph while independently freezing named owners and exactly eight markers.
resolutions: The final confirmed spec, accepted Decision 0067, and replacement plan/decomposition/graph form the current downstream contract; normal recorders replace the explicitly inoperative old artifacts before delegation.
The replacement plan, graph, decomposition, and First task plan assign complete D-0032 to NATIVE-FOREGROUND-ACTIVATE; Lean consumes it without reimplementation.
Decision 0067, the spec, architecture, and replacement artifacts use one task selected pointer. Fixed paths are one-time upgrade input only; review-run remains an input token.
Portable explicitly owns global-preflight origin=upgrade migration, including historical sealed-marker binding, before machinery replacement.
Decision 0067 amends Decision 0054: a draft PR is allowed only when required platform CI needs it, grants no proof, and receives formal review only after platform evidence passes.
The amended plan, graph and decomposition make Format commit the pinned requirements and final Ruff configuration and make Quality consume those exact bytes while owning semantic enforcement.

The final spec distinguishes managed status/approval/evidence writes, which require owning commands, from in-scope Main-authored ordinary canon source. Worker writes still require admission; strict-role and classifier behavior remains coherent.
Decision 0061 remains authoritative: necessary approvals use ordinary chat where host rules require it, and the owning approval/decision command binds the exact final revision.
Optional non-gate questions use empty scope/input fields and cannot satisfy a gate or approval.

Question identity is simplified to runtime, session, fresh event ID, and zero-based question index plus exact scope, current input digest, content, and answer. Approval-bound changes use the owning decision/approval; no revision map is added.
The invented live handoff is removed. Decision 0053 allows only a between-task coordinator change after the old session stops and the completed marker and green CI reach refreshed trunk.
An unanswered ordinary-chat question holds its turn. Abandonment grants no authority; a later coordinator asks again. No machine handoff predicate claims to observe chat.
There is no handoff snapshot, counter, fencing token, or live-transfer command. The new coordinator resumes through forge next at a completed task boundary.

Existing events remain best-effort diagnostics under Decision 0017. Committed hook configuration, focused tests, and recorder-produced automated logs carry required proof and real host-blocking outcomes.

The final spec captures each input once as immutable safe UTF-8 bytes with hash/count, requires known limits, launches only captured bytes, and partitions only under a declared ordered all-or-nothing aggregation contract.
AC6 now scopes exact-task proof to task-bound gates and explicitly preserves existing global and story recorder identities.

The simplified combined review uses exact full-line lens markers, exact chunk labels, one lowercase tag, and a deterministic NFC repo-path/line/normalized-title cross-lens fingerprint; no AFFECTS protocol or extra record family exists.
AC8, AC12, and Portable require immutable bundles, exact IDs/payload readback, collisions, retry, and late-event refusal while preserving legacy/history bytes.
AC7 reuses the task binary branch diff and cites one qualifying hunk correlated to admitted write, terminal evidence, and a criterion/finding. No product-tree snapshot exists.
The final spec makes local Mac CLI and Desktop evidence mandatory. Only unavailable Linux/Windows live CLI/Desktop runtime observations may remain accepted limitations; missing Mac evidence blocks.
Setup and forge doctor choose a coordinator for one invocation by argument, environment, detection, then TTY. Init/adopt/upgrade install both adapters and persist no choice.
The final spec leaves the complete graph to the approved plan/decomposition while retaining only the explicitly settled First D-0032 and Portable migration owners.

rounds.question: Dual-coordinator review migration: should Forge remove ongoing fixed-path review compatibility and use one Portable-owned upgrade migration into canonical task-scoped selected review sets?

summary: Resolved all 22 findings from the single genuine Sol/high requirements cold read against the final confirmed simplified specification, accepted Decisions 0066 and 0067, renumbered model policy Decision 0068, and the replacement artifacts now aligned to validated main c9a705bc. No second requirements cold read is run; this record refreshes the exact requirements digest after the inherited baseline merge.
current_flow: Record this requirements pass, finish exact graph/hash alignment, then run the one user-requested final cold read of the simplified plan.
